definition: Pertinacious means holding firmly, even stubbornly, to a purpose.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word pertinacious. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know pertinacious should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: His pertinacious refusal to sell the corner house outlasted three developers and ten years of rising offers.
Determined stops short of pertinacious — determination pursues a goal, while pertinacity refuses to release it after everyone else has.
Obsessive goes further than pertinacious — the obsessive could no longer let go even if they chose to.

Dogged means grinding steadily on through difficulty — head down, effort renewed, stamina admired. Pertinacious adds a different note: the grip itself cannot be pried loose, even after everyone advises letting go, and the word often carries a raised eyebrow. Dogged praises the effort; pertinacious marks the refusal to release.

Persistent is the plain, everyday word for continuing despite difficulty — a persistent cough, a persistent salesman. Pertinacious sits a shade past it: persistence keeps trying, while the pertinacious cannot be pried off the purpose at all, by fatigue, refusal, or embarrassment. Choose persistent for effort, pertinacious for the unshakable grip.
